listed_sector_signals.signal: A cited reference concerns harmonic mitigation in a steel mill power system (steel primary-metals context), though only appearing as a citation title, not the paper's own application
listed_sector_signals.quote:
B. Park et al., "Harmonic Mitigation Using Passive Harmonic Filters: 
Case Study in a Steel Mill Power System," Energies, vol. 14, no. 8, p. 
2278, 2021
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

one_line: The paper designs and simulates an energy management system (PV, LiFePO4 battery, solar forecasting, harmonic filtering) for electrifying a lumber (sawmill) milling operation toward net-zero energy, a discrete wood-processing industrial context rather than continuous-flow production; a steel mill appears only as a cited reference.
